content:
# Revision and Validation Audit

## Replaced obsolete behavior

- Replaced four-axis scoring with all eight canonical axes.
- Replaced the incomplete 55-profile runtime list with all 81 canonical profiles.
- Replaced 14 legacy classes and 112 legacy subclass options with the 22 merged classes and their 66 canonical subclasses.
- Removed legacy D&D class patron rules and the optional deity selector.
- Replaced Favor-centered patron tracking with Resonance, Divine Claim, Resolve, and Conviction Strain.
- Removed automatic race/class/deity moral modifiers that contradicted the new demonstrated-behavior rule.
- Replaced two traditional D&D alignment anchors with an eight-axis Snapshot.
- Added a 24-scenario Covenant Examination covering all eight axes.

## Canonical integrity checks

- Eight unique axes found.
- Exactly four profile axes and four expression axes found.
- All 81 low/neutral/high profile combinations resolve to exactly one registry entry.
- 22 creator families, 130 parent races, and 106 nested ancestry options found.
- 22 classes and 66 subclasses found.
- Every class resolves to an existing deity.
- Every class has a unique assigned deity; all 22 deities are used exactly once.
- Every creator family resolves to an existing creator deity.
- All quiz question effects reference valid axis IDs.
- All scores are clamped to 0–3000.
- Exact 1500 Pivot and all supplied 250-point phase steps are represented.

## Package checks

- Exactly one HTML file: `quiz.html`.
- No external links, fetch calls, frameworks, CDNs, or remote assets.
- JavaScript syntax checked with Node.js.
- Runtime and canonical JSON files parsed successfully.
- Interactive Snapshot and 24-question Examination smoke-tested in headless Chromium using an in-memory page equivalent of the offline package.
- Result rendering produced eight axis cards, a valid 81-profile title, class/deity covenant content, and all four tracker types without console or page errors.
